QuestInfo.name: My Cat Please
QuestInfo.0: Ulrika looks sad. Go speak to her and find out what's wrong.
QuestInfo.1: Ulrika has lost her cat #bMastema#k. Everything in and around town was search but the cat was not found so it must have gone into the mines. Ulrika says she cannot enter the mines because the adults in town forbid it and asks that you go find #bMastema#k for her.
QuestInfo.2: You caught Mastema running around in the mines and returned it to Ulrika.

0.0: Hey! Have you seen my cat? She purple, and about this high. You have to help me find her, because I heard cats who run away never return home!

yes.0: I've searched all day, and I think she must've left town. The grown-ups say it's too dangerous for me to go to #b#MDmirrorD_325_2_##k, but I bet that's where #bMastema#k went. Can you go get her?

1.0: Mastema! I was so worried about you! Come here and give me a big hug!

yes.0: Thanks for getting my cat back. She was upset because I've been too busy with school to play with her, but I promise to play with her more!

default.0: I've been so busy with school that I haven't been able to give #bMastema#k my undivided attention. I don't blame her for being mad. But I can't go to #b#MDmirrorD_325_2_##k to get her.
